illustrated.label: Illustrated
illustrated.directions: Colorful, format-adapted illustrations; warm paper or light backgrounds; expressive icons, watercolor or painterly scenes where useful. Use visual metaphors and hierarchy. Preserve a recognizable format, not just decorated text.

ink.label: Monochrome Ink
ink.directions: Black ink on warm white paper, pen hatching, hand-ruled borders, doodles and readable handwritten-style headings. Use line weight and whitespace rather than color to establish hierarchy. Preserve legible body text.

editorial.label: Editorial
editorial.directions: White background, near-black sans-serif typography, restrained red accents and gray, flat geometric symbols, clear grids and strong hierarchy. Avoid painterly textures and handwriting. Comic characters may use neutral skin tones. Preserve method-specific diagrams and narrative panels.
